title: LiveForkRequest
description: Fork a stored Live session onto a new WebRTC connection. Omit session or send an empty object to inherit its configuration.

session.description: Optional configuration overrides for the new Live session. Omit this object or send an empty object to inherit the stored session's settings.

transport.description: WebRTC transport with an SDP offer for the new connection to the forked session.

LiveAllowedServerEventParam.description: A Live server event selector for the WebRTC frontend data channel.

type.description: The outer Live server event type. Use 'response.event' for Responses events.

response_event.description: The nested Responses event type. Required when type is 'response.event'; forbidden for other event types.

LiveClientConfigParam.description: Startup-only capabilities for an untrusted frontend attached to a unified WebRTC session. Trusted sideband connections are unaffected.

data_channel.description: Client and server event permissions for the WebRTC frontend data channel.

LiveDataChannelConfigParam.description: Control which Live events an untrusted WebRTC frontend can send and receive over its data channel. These restrictions do not apply to trusted sideband connections.

allowed_client_events.description: Client event types that the frontend data channel may send. Use 'all' to allow every client event; an empty array allows none. Omission preserves the existing allow-all behavior.

items.description: A Live client event type allowed on the frontend data channel, such as `session.input_audio.mute`.

allowed_server_events.description: Server events that may be sent to the frontend data channel. Use 'all' to allow every server event; an empty array allows none. Omission preserves the existing allow-all behavior. Responses events use an object with type 'response.event' and a response_event selector.

LiveDelegationReasoningInputParam.description: Reasoning options for Responses requests made on behalf of the Live session.

anyOf.description: How much reasoning effort the delegated Responses model should use. Supported values depend on the backend model.
The reasoning summary to request from the delegated Responses model, when supported.

LiveDelegationTextInputParam.description: Text generation options for the Live session’s Responses backend.

anyOf.description: The amount of detail in text generated by the Responses backend. This does not configure the Live model’s spoken delivery.

LiveFunctionToolInputParam.description: A function tool available to the Responses backend when the Live model delegates a task.

name.description: The name the delegated Responses model uses when calling this function.

anyOf.description: What the function does and when the delegated Responses model should call it.
A JSON Schema object describing the arguments accepted by the function.
Whether the delegated Responses model must follow the function’s parameter schema exactly.

LiveMediaSessionForkParams.description: Optional overrides for a stored Live session. Omitted settings are inherited. The model, voice, frontend instructions, and prior conversation come from the stored session. WebRTC negotiates its audio format; audio.format is only supported on WebSocket forks.

LiveResponsesDelegationSettingsUpdateInp.description: Updates to the Responses backend of an existing Live session. Omitted settings retain their current values.

model.description: The Responses backend model to use for subsequent delegated requests. Omit to keep the current backend model.

anyOf.description: Instructions for the delegated Responses model, separate from Live instructions. See [backend prompting](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/live-delegation#start-with-your-existing-backend-prompt).
Maximum number of output tokens for each delegated response.
Service tier for delegated Responses requests.
Reasoning settings passed to each delegated Responses request.
Text generation settings passed to each delegated Responses request.

tools.description: Tools available to the Responses backend while it handles tasks delegated by the Live model.

tool_choice.description: Controls which tool the Responses backend uses when handling a task delegated by the Live model.

anyOf.description: Whether the delegated Responses model may request multiple tool calls in a single response.

LiveResponsesDelegationUpdateParam.description: Update the Responses backend for an existing Live session without changing delegation ownership.

type.description: The delegation owner. Always `responses` for tasks handled by the Responses API.

responses.description: Responses backend settings to update. Omitted settings keep their existing values.

LiveWebRTCTransport.description: WebRTC transport carrying the offer SDP in a creation request or answer SDP in its response.

type.description: The transport used for the Live session. Always `webrtc`.

sdp.description: Session Description Protocol message for the WebRTC connection.

LiveWebSearchToolInputParam.description: A web search tool available to the Live session’s Responses backend.

properties-store.description: Whether to store the forked session. Omission inherits the stored session's setting.
